summary: Haleon plc filed a Form 6-K reporting routine open-market share repurchases under its previously announced buyback programme. The filing details daily purchases on 26-29 May 2026 of about 10.15 million shares at prices ranging from 336.1 to 346.0 pence per share, all for cancellation. This is a standard capital return execution, not a special situation like a tender offer or going-private transaction. No board recommendation, advisor, or structural conditions are discussed. The aggregate voting rights figure is provided for UK disclosure purposes only. Routine buybacks do not constitute a special-situations event.
